description: The Mapas collection of the institutional repository of Costa Rica's Ministry of Public Works and Transport (MOPT) holds maps of the national road network produced by the ministry's sectoral planning directorate. The collection read on 2026-09-28 contains 28 items, such as maps of the classified national road network by surface type for the province of Limón (2011, at 1:320,000) and of the classified national network for Limón (2013), with similar sheets for other provinces. Coverage is Costa Rica by province. Access is free download from the repository; no licence is stated. Caveats: the maps are PDFs from about a decade ago, so classification and surface type may have changed, and they are not GIS layers. It supports network descriptions and surface-type proxies for condition in road network and hazard exposure studies of Costa Rica, such as landslide exposure of unpaved national routes. Related records: data-cfia-costa-rica-apc-construction-statistics and data-ice-costa-rica-transmission-open-data are other Costa Rican infrastructure sources.
